title: CAP: Learning to Optimize from Sparse Observations of Related Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In experiment-driven black-box optimization, each evaluation can consume materials, equipment time, and other resources, limiting the number of experiments available for a new task. Records from completed related optimization campaigns could help, but learning a sequential query policy remains challenging when task-specific experience consists of only a few sparse histories. We propose CAP (Candidate Acquisition Policy), which models shared structure and task-specific variation in fixed historical records to sample interactive practice functions. On these functions, CAP learns a feedback-conditioned query policy aimed at final optimization performance under a fixed evaluation budget. At deployment, its parameters remain fixed while each new observation informs the next query. translated_title: CAP：从相关任务的稀疏观测中学习优化
translated_abstract: 在以实验驱动的黑盒优化中，每次评估都可能消耗材料、设备时间及其他资源，这限制了可用于新任务的实验次数。已完成的相关优化活动的记录或许能提供帮助，但当任务特定的经验仅由少量稀疏的历史记录构成时，学习序贯查询策略仍然充满挑战。我们提出了CAP（Candidate Acquisition Policy，候选采集策略），该方法对固定历史记录中的共享结构与任务特定变化进行建模，以采样交互式练习函数。在这些练习函数上，CAP学习一个以反馈为条件的查询策略，目标是在固定评估预算下实现最终的优化性能。在部署阶段，其参数保持固定，而每一次新的观测都会为下一次查询提供信息。在跨越6维和20维的五个合成任务族以及BOPTEST和SU2两个工程仿真基准上，CAP取得了最低的中位数最终预算……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CAP通过对相关任务稀疏历史记录中的共享结构与任务特定变化建模来生成模拟练习函数，并在其上训练反馈条件化的查询策略，从而在固定评估预算下实现更优的黑盒优化性能。
en_tdlr: CAP models shared structure and task-specific variation in sparse historical records from related optimization tasks to sample practice functions, on which it learns a feedback-conditioned query policy that achieves superior black-box optimization performance under a fixed evaluation budget.
